title: Prospective Evaluation of the Biomechanical Properties of the Thoracic Aorta Coupling Magnetic Resonance Imaging and In-vitro Elasticity Tests in Patients With Ascending Aortic Aneurysm
official: Prospective Evaluation of the Biomechanical Properties of the Thoracic Aorta Coupling Magnetic Resonance Imaging and In-vitro Elasticity Tests in Patients With Ascending Aortic Aneurysm
summary: The biomechanical properties of the aorta are currently poorly understood. A better understanding would optimize surgical indications and monitoring techniques for patients with thoracic aortic aneurysms.
conditions: Patient With Ascending Aortic Aneurysm With Surgical Indication for Replacement
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Person who has given oral consent
* Patient with ascending aortic aneurysm with surgical indication for replacement
* Age \> 18 years old
* Scheduled surgery

Exclusion Criteria:

* Person not affiliated to the national health insurance system
* Protected adult
* Pregnant or breastfeeding woman
* MRI Contraindication
* Emergency surgical procedure
